build_r2plus1d_34_model: build a R(2+1)D-34 video classification model using Conv2Plus1D convolutions and BasicBlock
build_ip_csn_152_model: build an IP-CSN-152 video classification model using IPConv3DDepthwise convolutions and Bottleneck blocks
create_bninception_video_model: create a BNInceptionVideo frame-level model that runs BNInception on each video frame separately
create_timm_model_wrapper: create a TIMMModel wrapper that runs a timm vision model on each video frame independently
run_process_each_frame: run process_each_frame to pass each frame of a video tensor through a model separately
